name: io.github.Open-Self/openself
title: OpenSelf
description: The user-owned context layer for AI agents: private, portable, provenance-aware memory with policy-controlled access, tamper-evident audit, and verifiable context receipts.

environmentVariables.name: DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory holding the encrypted context vault (default ./data)

environmentVariables.name: OPENSELF_EMBEDDINGS
environmentVariables.description: Embedding provider: feature-hash (default, offline), ollama, or openai-compatible

environmentVariables.name: OPENSELF_OLLAMA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama base URL when OPENSELF_EMBEDDINGS=ollama (default http://127.0.0.1:11434)

environmentVariables.name: OPENSELF_EMBEDDINGS_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Embedding model name for ollama/openai-compatible providers

environmentVariables.name: OPENSELF_EMBEDDINGS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint when OPENSELF_EMBEDDINGS=openai-compatible

environmentVariables.name: OPENSELF_EMBEDDINGS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the openai-compatible provider (falls back to OPENAI_API_KEY)
